scope: Local binary-fixture compatibility tests only. No RPC calls, public-network transactions or browser wallet operations.
checks: u64 fee caps and supply preserved exactly
raw spendable token balance does not subtract withheld fees twice
active transfer hook rejected; inactive hook permitted
changed current/pending/nonfinite scaled multiplier rejected; 1 preserved
unknown mint extension and changed manifest rejected
wrong mint decimals, uninitialized and missing mint rejected
wrong token mint and spending authority rejected
unexpected delegate or close authority rejected
required incoming memo rejected; inactive memo permitted
confidential, CPI guard and unknown account extensions rejected
